propositions: Non-bug tickets (task/story/epic) have no truthful administrative disposition exit when the completion verifier cannot PASS, forcing operators to use --force instead of a sanctioned close path.

The close-class vocabulary is incompletely scoped: duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated exist but obsolete/superseded/wontfix are absent, and type-gating in close_precheck.py:64 restricts the path to bugs only.
The completion-FAIL message does not enumerate the applicable --class values for a ticket's type, leaving operators unaware a disposition alternative exists.
Reason-capable administrative classes (obsolete/wontfix) require user-supplied justification but lack a write-side enforcement mechanism and a non-force channel to supply it.
Reason-only administrative dispositions must mint SIGNED attestations distinct from replacement-bearing closures, and the manifest must carry the class and reason.
The --reason flag is gated to --force-only transitions today, blocking its use for non-force administrative closes that require reasons.
